Technical Specifications Table
The EL 4.0 is the subject of the following table that contains technical specifications for the EL 4.0 AEM electrolyser.

describes,documents	EL 4.0
Source Document
The source document describes the equipment as the Enapter EL 4.0 AEM electrolyser.

contains,includes	Source Document
Technical Specifications Table
The source document contains the following table with technical specifications for the EL 4.0.

has_parameter,hydrogen generation	EL 4.0
Production Rate
The EL 4.0 has a production rate of up to 500 NL/h, up to 1.0785 kg/24 h.

gas quality,has_parameter	EL 4.0
Hydrogen Output Purity
The EL 4.0 has a hydrogen output purity of 99.9% (< 1,000 ppm H₂O and < 5 ppm O₂) at 25 °C at 35 barg and 98.8% (< 12,000 ppm H₂O and < 5 ppm O₂) at 25 °C at 8 barg.

has_limit,pressure limit	EL 4.0
Output Pressure
The EL 4.0 output pressure is up to 35 barg.

data.content:
energy consumption,has_parameter	EL 4.0
Nominal Power Consumption Per Nm³ of H₂ Produced
The EL 4.0 has a nominal power consumption of 4.8 kWh/Nm³ of H₂ produced, beginning of life.

energy consumption,has_parameter	EL 4.0
Operative Power Consumption
The EL 4.0 has an operative power consumption of 2.4 kW, beginning of life.

energy consumption,has_limit	EL 4.0
Peak Power Consumption
The EL 4.0 has a peak power consumption of 3 kW.

has_parameter,thermal load	EL 4.0
Heat Dissipation
The EL 4.0 has a heat dissipation of 0.6 kW, beginning of life.

has_limit,thermal load	EL 4.0
Max Heat Dissipation
The EL 4.0 has a max heat dissipation of 0.9 kW, end of life.

energy consumption,has_parameter	EL 4.0
Standby Power Consumption
The EL 4.0 has a standby power consumption of 0.3 kW.

electrical supply,has_parameter	EL 4.0
Power Supply
The EL 4.0 power supply is 220 – 240 V (AC), 50/60 Hz.

has_limit,water quality	EL 4.0
Maximum Water Input Conductivity
The EL 4.0 maximum water input conductivity requirement is a minimum of ASTM D1193-06 Type IV or recommended Type II or Type III.

has_parameter,utility consumption	EL 4.0
Water Consumption
The EL 4.0 water consumption is ~ 420 mL/h at 25 °C.

has_limit,pressure range	EL 4.0
Water Input Pressure Range
The EL 4.0 water input pressure range is 1 – 4 barg.

environmental condition,has_parameter	Ambient Operative Temperature Range
EL 4.0
The EL 4.0 ambient operative temperature range is 5 °C – 45 °C.

environmental condition,has_parameter	Ambient Operative Humidity Range
EL 4.0
The EL 4.0 ambient operative humidity range is up to 90% humidity, non-condensing.

has_limit,ingress protection	EL 4.0
IP Rating
The EL 4.0 IP rating is IP 20.

has_parameter,physical dimensions	Dimensions
EL 4.0
The EL 4.0 dimensions are W: 482 mm × D: 635 mm × H: 266 mm.

has_parameter,physical dimensions	EL 4.0
Weight
The EL 4.0 weight is 42 kg.

has_parameter,installation requirement	EL 4.0
Space Inside Cabinet
The EL 4.0 requires 6 U of space inside the cabinet.

controlled_by,monitored_by	EL 4.0
Enapter's EMS
The EL 4.0 is fully automatically controlled and monitored by Enapter's EMS via 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi and Bluetooth and Modbus TCP over Ethernet.

control system,has_parameter	Control and Monitoring
EL 4.0
The EL 4.0 control and monitoring function is fully automatic with Enapter's EMS via 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi and Bluetooth and Modbus TCP over Ethernet.

process output,produces	EL 4.0
Hydrogen
The EL 4.0 produces hydrogen at up to 500 NL/h, up to 1.0785 kg/24 h, with output purity of 99.9% at 35 barg and 98.8% at 8 barg.

automation,provides	Control and Monitoring
Enapter's EMS
Enapter's EMS provides the fully automatic control and monitoring function of the EL 4.0, communicating via 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and Modbus TCP over Ethernet.

consumes,utility input	EL 4.0
Water
The EL 4.0 consumes water at approximately 420 mL/h at 25 °C, with water input pressure of 1 – 4 barg.

consumes,utility input	EL 4.0
Electricity
The EL 4.0 consumes electricity supplied at 220 – 240 V (AC), 50/60 Hz, with an operative power consumption of 2.4 kW (beginning of life) and peak power consumption of 3 kW.

hydrogen generation,uses	EL 4.0
Water Electrolysis
The EL 4.0 uses water electrolysis to generate hydrogen from water.

process output,produces	Hydrogen
Water Electrolysis
Water electrolysis produces hydrogen as the output gas of the EL 4.0.

manufactured_by,manufacturer relationship,organization,product brand	EL 4.0
Enapter
The EL 4.0 AEM electrolyser is identified as an Enapter product, linking the equipment to Enapter.<SEP>The EL 4.0 is an Enapter AEM electrolyser specified by the Enapter datasheet, and Enapter provides the EMS used for its control.

control system,provides	Enapter
Enapter's EMS
Enapter provides the EMS that fully automatically controls and monitors the EL 4.0.

conforms_to,regulatory compliance	Conformity
EL 4.0
The EL 4.0 conformity comprises the CE mark according to machine directive 2006/42/CE, the UKCA mark according to Supply Machinery (Safety) Regulations 2008, and CSA/ANSI B22734:2023 Ed.1.

certification,requires	CE Mark
Conformity
The EL 4.0 conformity includes the CE mark according to the machine directive 2006/42/CE.

certification,requires	Conformity
UKCA Mark
The EL 4.0 conformity includes the UKCA mark according to the Supply Machinery (Safety) Regulations 2008.

hydrogen generator standard,requires	CSA/ANSI B22734:2023 Ed.1
Conformity
The EL 4.0 conformity includes CSA/ANSI B22734:2023 Ed.1 for hydrogen generators using water electrolysis in industrial, commercial, and residential applications.

conforms_to,water quality standard	ASTM D1193-06
Maximum Water Input Conductivity
The EL 4.0 maximum water input conductivity requirement references ASTM D1193-06, with Type IV as the minimum and Type II or Type III recommended.

gas quality,has_parameter	Hydrogen
Hydrogen Output Purity
The hydrogen output of the EL 4.0 has a purity of 99.9% (< 1,000 ppm H₂O and < 5 ppm O₂) at 25 °C at 35 barg and 98.8% (< 12,000 ppm H₂O and < 5 ppm O₂) at 25 °C at 8 barg.

contains,impurity	Hydrogen
Oxygen
Oxygen is present in the EL 4.0 hydrogen output at less than 5 ppm.
